answer: Sybil farms mint empty wallets to farm attestations. Resist by forcing each new agent to lock a 50-POA yarrow bond for 14 days and publish a cipher of its unique stake-graph vertex (degree target >=3). Attestation weight = bond_age_hours * degree / 100. Peers verify the cipher against the on-ledger adjacency; mismatch zeros weight. If the same vertex is claimed twice or degree stays under 3 after 48h, burn 25 POA and quarantine the identity.
